title: Developer halts work on Jeddah tower after funding gap
text: Work on the 60-storey tower has stopped indefinitely while the developer seeks new investors.

title: Ministry withdraws metro extension contract from contractor
text: The transport ministry has withdrawn the Phase 2 contract after the contractor failed to meet mobilisation milestones.

title: Airport expansion now expected to open in 2029 instead of 2027
text: The opening of the new terminal has slipped by two years after design changes and late approvals.

title: Contractor bags $1.2bn housing deal in Riyadh
text: A local contractor has been selected to build 8000 homes under a government housing programme.

title: Stadium budget doubles to $4bn
text: The cost of the new stadium has doubled from its original estimate due to design upgrades and material inflation.

title: Saudi Arabia introduces new building code for high-rise towers
text: A new mandatory fire and structural code will apply to all towers above 20 storeys from January.

title: Steel rebar shortages slow projects across the UAE
text: Contractors report rebar deliveries taking up to 12 weeks as port congestion worsens.

title: Subcontractors say main contractors owe them months of arrears
text: Small subcontractors report invoices outstanding for over 180 days on several government-funded projects.

title: Engineering firm lays off 400 engineers in Dubai
text: The firm is cutting 400 jobs as its pipeline of new work shrinks.

title: Construction firm posts record half-year profit
text: Net income rose 40% on higher margins from infrastructure work.

title: Kuwait construction output expected to grow 4% next year
text: Analysts forecast steady growth in Kuwaiti construction driven by oil-sector and housing spending.

title: Giga-project scaled down to a third of original size
text: The developer said the scheme would now cover 30% of its original footprint after a strategic review.

title: Contractor files for insolvency leaving hospital project unfinished
text: The contractor's collapse has left a 500-bed hospital half-built with no replacement appointed.

title: Labour ministry tightens worker housing rules
text: New rules set minimum space and ventilation standards for construction worker accommodation.

title: Red Sea attacks push up freight costs for building materials
text: Shipping lines are rerouting vessels around Africa adding three weeks and higher insurance costs to imports.

title: Road project handover pushed back by one week
text: The handover ceremony for the coastal road was moved by one week to accommodate officials' schedules.

title: Qatar awards fall 40% as World Cup pipeline winds down
text: Project awards in Qatar fell sharply year on year with few large tenders in the market.

title: Developer terminates design consultant after dispute
text: The developer ended the consultant's appointment following a dispute over fees and design scope.

title: Contractor wins arbitration over unpaid variation claims
text: A tribunal ordered the employer to pay $85m in outstanding variation claims to the contractor.

title: Cement prices jump 25% after kiln closures
text: Two cement plants have shut kilns for maintenance pushing prices up across the region.
